the content of the IG's inputs as `ig-ast.ts digest` reads them (tree-scoped, never commit-scoped: a merge, rebase or README-only commit leaves the key alone), plus the Publisher toolchain the manifest records; the branch name is keyed by the IG's package id, never by a hand list of files

]

savePolicy
default branch only: seeded when the built commit is an ancestor of the default branch's tip and sushi-config.yaml, ig.ini and input/ are the same at both (Process_IgAstCache GW_Seedable); any other ref keeps its AST as a run artifact and leaves the cache alone
verify
`ig-cache.sh verify` runs `ig-ast.ts validity`: the digest of the IG's inputs now (or as committed at `--at <rev>`) against the manifest's inputs.inputDigest. Exit 0 valid, 1 stale-inputs (naming the input), 2 cannot-tell; anything but valid is a miss, so a bad entry costs a rebuild and is never built from

notes
Restored only by steps that build or render an IG (owner, 2026-11-05: "not all rendering/CI/merge processes need all caches. be optimal"): never by a test shard, a gate or a merge job. Process_IgAstCache is this cache's component process; Process_Cache (cat-harness) draws it as a task in its own lane, since a lower layer cannot call into this one: Task_Restore and GW_Valid are its verify, Task_Seed its save. The old `cat-fhir-ast/` and `fhir-ast/` branch names are retired (bean oycs), so they are not read. Every restore and refresh prints one line in cached-step's format: `**cached-step `ig-ast`: hit|warm|miss** (exact) — <why>. Key `<input digest>`.`
